english.note: Use this when the flightiness mainly shows as impulsive, rash, or careless actions.
Use this especially when the rash behaviour is careless, impulsive, or socially tactless.

examples.english: I don't dare let them drive alone; they are too flighty.
examples.traditional: 我唔敢畀佢一個人揸車，佢做事太冒失喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gam2 bei2 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zaa1 ce1 keoi5 zou6 si6 taai3 mou6 sat1 laa3

examples.english: You’re so rash, asking someone when they’re getting married the first time you meet them.
examples.traditional: 你咁冒失，第一次見人就問人幾時結婚。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 mou6 sat1 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 jan4 zau6 man6 jan4 gei2 si4 git3 fan1
